name: NEURA MiPA
summary: A wheeled German service robot with two light arms (3 kg per arm) and swappable attachments for carrying and handing items indoors; reservation only.

germany.statusNote: Made in Germany. Refundable 100 EUR reservation on the NEURA site for the MiPA Home model; release expected in late 2026. Commercial buyers are sent to the sales contact. No deliveries confirmed.

priceEur.note: Introductory price for the MiPA Home model for private households only; commercial pricing on request.

sellers.name: NEURA Robotics GmbH
sellers.note: Online reservation for MiPA Home; commercial and industrial inquiries via the NEURA sales contact.

specs.label: Degrees of freedom
specs.conditions: Base robot without end effectors (datasheet); reservation page says 16 DoF

specs.label: Motion endurance
specs.conditions: Range as given on the datasheet; automatic recharging

specs.label: Sensors
specs.value: LiDAR, navigation sensors, RGB camera and webcam, ultrasonic, temperature, humidity; touch display, projector, microphone array

capabilities.sdk: Open platform with APIs; no-code apps via Neuraverse
notes: Indoor service robot; attachments: backpack, shelf, table, hook, clip, tool change.
Two small arms with simple hands on a wheeled column with a linear axis.
Runtime given only as a 2-8 h range.
roughGround and stairs set to false because the robot drives on small wheels and the maker names indoor uses only.
